title: Jenkins policy validation for AI Guard (Zscaler example): the declarative pipeline around the shared scan_policy.py

prose.text: Zscaler's Jenkins example runs the same AI Guard policy validation as the GitHub Actions example, from a Declarative Pipeline.

checks.do: Use FORCE_RUN or a change to a monitored path when the scan stage was skipped; a requirements change alone does not trigger it.

pipeline.statement: The Jenkins example's Declarative Pipeline polls SCM every five minutes and runs the AI Guard scan stage only when `FORCE_RUN` is set or a change touches `config/model-config.yaml`, `config/test-prompts.yaml`, `scripts/scan_policy.py` or the `Jenkinsfile`; the key comes from the `aiguard-api-key` secret-text credential and the cloud and policy ID from build parameters (cloud default `us1`).

quotes: if (params.FORCE_RUN) { echo 'FORCE_RUN enabled — skipping change detection.' env.SCAN_NEEDED = 'true'
if (changes.any { scanPaths.contains(it) }) { echo 'Monitored paths changed — running AI Guard policy scan.' env.SCAN_NEEDED = 'true'
stage('Zscaler AI Guard Policy Validation') { when { expression { env.SCAN_NEEDED == 'true' } }

same-scanner.statement: The Jenkins `scan_policy.py` is the GitHub Actions scanner with only comment changes, so test-case format, pass and fail rules and configuration are those of [[ai-security.ai-guard.integrations.github-actions]].

quotes: Anthropic, Cursor, and GitHub Actions integrations.

same-scanner.conditions: A diff of github-actions/scripts/scan_policy.py and Jenkins/declarative-pipeline/scripts/scan_policy.py at the pin differs only in a docstring line and a comment; config/test-prompts.yaml is identical.

deploy-stages.statement: The optional Vertex AI deploy and endpoint-test stages run only when `SCAN_NEEDED` is true (the condition the scan stage runs on), `SKIP_DEPLOY` is off and the branch is main.

quotes: allOf { expression { env.SCAN_NEEDED == 'true' } expression { !params.SKIP_DEPLOY } expression { env.GIT_BRANCH == 'main' || env.GIT_BRANCH == 'origin/main' } }
